about_the_game:
Run. Hide. Survive. In the world of Brainrot Nightmares, the viral insanity of Italian Brainrot turns deadly. Meet Tung Tung Sahur, a hulking wooden beast with a cursed baseball bat, and he’s hunting YOU

About This Game
You wake in a rotting mansion with no memory. Your only hope is to unravel the mansion’s cursed secrets, solve its puzzles, and stay one step ahead of the Brainrot beast. But every creak, every shadow, every absurd whisper pulls you deeper into the rot. Will you outsmart the hunter, or become another meme in his twisted gallery?

Key Features

  • Chasing: A horror packed with tension, jump scares, and Brainrot absurdity—perfect for a scream night.

  • Outrun Tung Tung Sahur: Dodge the bat-wielding nightmare. Hide in closets and pray he doesn’t hear you.

  • Puzzles: Crack riddles to unlock paths, from decoding Brainrot symbols to finding a key—all while Tung Tung is hunting you!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 Bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 ／ Intel Core i5-7500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 470 with 4GB VRAM ／ NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 with 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 ／ Intel Core i7 8700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700／ NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Flee Tung Tung Sahur, a bat-wielding Brainrot monster, in a cursed mansion. Hide, solve puzzles, and survive the meme-charged terror. “Tung Tung, you can’t escape!”
